sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 8 (task_identity_is_coherent) and Internal Quality Checks row 8 (same text, no extra annotation columns populated); Deterministic Checks rows check-task-name.py and check-task-slug.sh
evidence: Name/slug: task.toml:5 name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations"; manifest.json task = "projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations", so name equals turing/<dirname> with org turing (staged). Slug has 3 hyphen tokens (within check-task-slug.sh limit). The frozen task.toml is byte-identical to the project copy (sha256 ac664d0e...8f26 for both). Description (task.toml:6) 'Recruiting workspace with a shared pipeline board and recruiter-candidate conversations that stay correct and usable while several people work at once.' names this product and its actual axes: instruction.md:1-9 (pipeline board per job, conversations per application, concurrent users). Keywords (task.toml:7) recruiting/pipeline/messaging/realtime/webdev/turing/full-stack all match (hireops_rules.md section 5: updates within 15 s; section 6 conversations); required template keywords webdev/turing/full-stack preserved. Metadata: difficulty = "hard" with difficulty_explanation (task.toml:11) whose every clause traces to the public rules: one-step moves, interview capacity and role rules (hireops_rules.md section 3 'Moving a card', 'Interview places', 'Who may move what'), stale moves refused and explained (section 3 'Two people at once', 409 + who), all-or-nothing bulk moves and undo only while untouched ('Moving several together', 'Undo'), per-person unread/seen, paged history keeping place, drafts surviving reload and ended session (section 6), live updates not disturbing typing/focus/scroll (section 5), candidates never receiving staff-only data (section 7). category = "programming" and tags match the contract/template (staged-task-contract.md lines 48-49). provenance and arena_slice ('recruiting-hiring-operations') describe the same recruiting product. No quoted criterion counts in description/provenance, so no count drift possible. app_context.md 'Name: HireOps' and package.json name 'hireops' agree. No template placeholders (CHANGE_ME/change-me) or other-task names (e.g. Colderwater, codearena) remain anywhere in the frozen task (grep: no matches); no 'change desk'/'change set' remnants from the HEAD commit message appear in the frozen task, so the description does not advertise a removed feature. [task].version absent, which is optional per workbook row 8 and staged-task-contract.md line 77. Counterexample search: a broken or conforming app cannot affect this static metadata row; I looked for a description/explanation clause promising behavior absent from the brief (which would mislead about the task) and found none. Minor observation (not a defect under row 8): staged-task-contract.md line 42 comments that the description may mention judge and dimension policy; this description does not, but the row and quality-checks.md section 8 require only that it name the product and its actual axes, and the judge/weights live in [verifier.env] and scoring.toml per the cross-file table. Static check only; no runtime evidence is required for this row.
